The Children's Library will be temporarily closed for facility repairs during the following period.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

【Closure Period (All Day)】

December 4, 2025 (Friday) through January 15, 2026 (Friday)

【What to Do During the Closure】

• You cannot use the library's reading area, borrow books, or return books at the Children's Library during this period.

• If you have reserved materials set for pickup at the Children's Library, please pick them up at the Municipal Library instead.

• The book drop box will remain available throughout the closure period.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-lib.jp/calendar/post-85.html
